items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I went to Mr. Rivers, and I said to him... 'I heard that you were looking for a drummer. I would appreciate it if you would give me the opportunity to play in your band.'

ctx.x: Yeah, and they had some good restaurants.
Oh, yeah; they had the Boston Chop House, Salina's Tea Room, and Bill Rivers had a restuarant there.
Right. What was the name of that place Bill Rivers owned?
